execution_guard: Python audit hook rejected real socket creation/bind/connect/DNS, child spawning and process signals.
verified_scope: Exact prior four payloads and both unchanged codec hashes; independent raw wire reconstruction.
One loopback listener/connection, one owned receiver, one driver; literal 127.0.0.1 and ephemeral bind only.
Nonblocking read/write/connect/accept, absolute monotonic deadlines, bounded select, no progress reset, exact ACK and no ACK for wrong frame.
Actual positive byte accounting survives post-syscall deadline expiry; completed commands, active stage and partial totals survive ordinary failure.
Only direct owned Popen cleanup, retained attempted escalation/reap evidence, socket/journal failures do not bypass cleanup.
Pre-data source/inventory freeze and before/after provenance checks; reviewer-approved separate canary and collection receipts.
Two fixed sequential measurement runs; 160 measured rows, 80 pairs, 1600 measured exchanges; 32 warmups and 8 canary exchanges separate.
Fixed balanced AB/BA order, 196676-byte frame ceiling, bounded files and descriptive per-run summaries with no efficacy or device inference.
Independent verifier reconstructs schedules, payload hashes, counters, complete journals and summaries; rejects incomplete or failed artifacts.
resolved_draft_findings: Late successful syscall bytes were lost before post-syscall deadline checks.
Failures lacked partial totals and active command evidence.
Cleanup exceptions discarded owned-child attempted-signal and unreaped state.
Close/terminal-journal failures could prevent remaining cleanup or result preservation.
Admission/canary/previous-result provenance was not rechecked at completion.
limits: PASS is source-and-synthetic-test review only, not socket capability evidence or permission to collect.
The designated reviewer separately admits and reviews the bounded canary before measurement, and retains exact external admission/canary receipts.
User-space deadlines are not hard OS containment; scheduling, codec work and file syscalls may overshoot. Abrupt death may leave incomplete evidence.
Standalone verifier checks internal hash consistency, not malicious-producer honesty; the designated reviewer compares external receipts.
Root tests containing real timing/process experiments were intentionally unrun.
Any post-canary source change requires a new protocol version and fresh independent admission; failures are not replaced.
